run_lambda_handler: run the lambda handler to transform Facebook server-side event records from base64-encoded JSON into structured output with partition keys
parse_client_user_agent: parse a client user agent string to extract browser name, device OS, and OS version using regex patterns
process_client_ip_address: process a client IP address by returning IPv4 as-is, truncating IPv6 to first 64 bits, or returning empty for invalid
review_lambda_handler: review the lambda handler function that transforms Facebook pixel server-side event data for data ingestion pipelines
test_parse_client_user_agent: test the user agent parser function with sample browser strings to verify correct browser and OS detection
